metadata.description: Curated primary sources for mobile testing strategy, automation frameworks, release channels, accessibility, and device lab practices.
metadata.title: QA Testing Mobile - Sources

platform_docs.name: Apple XCTest Documentation
platform_docs.relevance: Core testing framework for iOS apps and UI automation.

platform_docs.name: Android Testing Documentation
platform_docs.relevance: Official Android test strategy, unit, and UI testing guidance.

platform_docs.name: Espresso Documentation
platform_docs.relevance: Primary Android UI testing framework reference.

platform_docs.name: Android Macrobenchmark
platform_docs.relevance: Android performance benchmarking for startup/jank regressions.

platform_docs.name: Swift Testing Documentation
platform_docs.relevance: Modern Swift unit/integration testing framework (complements XCTest; UI tests still use XCUITest).

platform_docs.name: Jetpack Compose Testing
platform_docs.relevance: Compose UI testing APIs and best practices (semantics, test tags, idling).

platform_docs.name: XCTest Accessibility Audit
platform_docs.relevance: Apple accessibility audit API for UI test coverage and release gates.

platform_docs.name: Xcode 26 Release Notes
platform_docs.relevance: Primary source for Xcode 26 known issues affecting test workflows: Allocations instrument miss-reporting for native Swift types, Coding Assistant Cancel unreliability, and default TLS Client Hello changes that can break staging test tiers.

platform_docs.name: Apple Developer Forums 762217 — UNUserNotificationCenter delegate isolation
platform_docs.relevance: Push-path crash class that must be validated during iOS push QA. Transport proof and app-open proof are separate gates.

platform_docs.name: Apple Developer Forums 796407 — Swift 6 UNUserNotificationCenter crash
platform_docs.relevance: Swift 6 strict-concurrency runtime check on UNUserNotificationCenter — affects test-harness auth-request flows and push smoke tests.

platform_docs.name: Compose Accessibility Testing
platform_docs.relevance: Android accessibility testing guidance for Compose-based UIs.

platform_docs.name: Apple TestFlight
platform_docs.relevance: Current iOS beta distribution and pre-release validation workflow.

platform_docs.name: Google Play Pre-Launch Reports
platform_docs.relevance: Android store-side automated device testing before rollout.

automation_tools.name: Appium 3 Migration Guide
automation_tools.relevance: Appium 3.x migration from 2.x: drops JSON Wire Protocol entirely (W3C only), requires Node ^20.19.0 || ^22.12.0 || >=24.0.0. Simpler migration than 1.x to 2.x. Latest stable is 3.5.x as of 2026-06 (github.com/appium/appium/releases).

automation_tools.name: Detox Documentation
automation_tools.relevance: End-to-end testing for React Native apps.

automation_tools.name: Maestro Documentation
automation_tools.relevance: Cross-platform mobile UI testing with YAML flows (smoke/regression breadth). Maestro MCP, Maestro Studio, and Maestro Cloud docs. Old domain maestro.mobile.dev redirects here.

automation_tools.name: Maestro MCP Server Documentation
automation_tools.relevance: Official Maestro MCP setup: integrating Maestro with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, and other AI IDEs.

automation_tools.name: Patrol (Flutter E2E)
automation_tools.relevance: Flutter E2E testing framework built on top of integration_test.

automation_tools.name: React Native Testing Overview
automation_tools.relevance: Official React Native testing guidance across unit, component, and end-to-end layers.

automation_tools.name: EAS Build and Submit (Expo)
automation_tools.relevance: Canonical CI binary pipeline for React Native / Expo: cloud-builds signed IPA/AAB and submits to TestFlight and Play Store.

automation_tools.name: Kotlin Multiplatform Run Tests
automation_tools.relevance: Official Kotlin Multiplatform test execution guidance for shared and platform tests.

automation_tools.name: Patrol 4.0 Release — LeanCode
automation_tools.relevance: Patrol 4.0 (December 2025): Flutter Web support, VS Code extension with working patrolTest() play button, improved debugging. Superseded by 4.6.x as of 2026-07; see Patrol MCP entry below for the current AI-agent integration.

automation_tools.name: Patrol MCP Release — LeanCode
automation_tools.relevance: Patrol MCP: exposes `patrol develop` to AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) for AI-assisted authoring/running/debugging of Flutter E2E tests. Flutter-ecosystem analogue of Maestro MCP. Stable Patrol release is 4.6.x as of 2026-07-11.

automation_tools.name: React Native 0.82 — New Architecture Only
automation_tools.relevance: React Native 0.82 removes the option to disable the New Architecture. New Architecture was the default since 0.76 (Oct 2024). Testing implication: Detox must be compatible with the installed RN version; confirm before upgrading.

device_labs.name: Firebase Test Lab
device_labs.relevance: Device lab for automated and exploratory mobile testing.

device_labs.name: AWS Device Farm
device_labs.relevance: Cloud device testing and CI integration.

device_labs.name: AWS Device Farm Pricing
device_labs.relevance: Live pricing and quota reference for procurement and budgeting.

device_labs.name: BrowserStack App Automate
device_labs.relevance: Device cloud for mobile automation and debugging.

device_labs.name: BrowserStack Maestro Getting Started
device_labs.relevance: Current BrowserStack guidance for running Maestro tests in App Automate.

device_labs.name: Firebase Test Lab Quotas And Pricing
device_labs.relevance: Current Firebase pricing and quota guidance used for Test Lab budgeting.

device_labs.name: Bitrise Virtual Device Testing
device_labs.relevance: Bitrise-hosted mobile CI testing path for simulator and virtual-device workflows.

device_labs.name: App Percy — BrowserStack Native App Visual Testing
device_labs.relevance: BrowserStack's dedicated visual regression platform for native iOS and Android apps. Includes Visual Review Agent (AI-powered bounding boxes and natural-language change summaries, 3x faster review). Distinct from Percy (which covers web/hybrid). Access to 30,000+ real devices.

accessibility_tools.name: axe DevTools for Mobile — Deque
accessibility_tools.relevance: Automated accessibility testing for native iOS and Android apps (and React Native, Flutter, .NET MAUI). Mobile analogue of axe-core: WCAG-mapped rule engine runs against native accessibility trees. Complements — does not replace — manual VoiceOver and TalkBack verification.

accessibility_tools.name: axe DevTools Mobile Documentation — Deque Docs
accessibility_tools.relevance: Official axe DevTools Mobile reference: iOS and Android setup, XCUITest and Appium integration, CI/CD pipeline integration, and rule reference.
